headline: Records Not Synced now says whether to fix a record in Xero or in Salesforce, and a brief Xero sign-in hiccup no longer raises an alarm.
whatsNew: Records Not Synced now says where to fix each record: Fix Xero for a bad value from Xero, Fix Salesforce for setup, or both when either side can fix it.
Records Not Synced now names the value Salesforce refused, such as an email address or a number out of range, and what to change.
